d: If you want more visible lower abs, pay attention to what happens *after* you bring your knees up. Can you curl your pelvis toward your chest, or do your legs move while your tailbone stays on the floor? That last part of the rep is easy to miss, and it can change how much work your abs actually do. In this video, I’m going to show you three lower ab exercises you can do at home, plus a bonus exercise for the pull-up bar. I’ll also cover where nutrition comes in if lower belly fat is hiding the muscle you’re working to build.
